text:
Maya: Quick sync — we need to align dependencies + sequencing for the Acme pilot. Customer requires private VPC + p99 <= 220ms. Who's blocked on what?
Ricardo: Runtime needs perf baseline + quant profiles. I estimate 2 sprints to produce reliable p99 numbers if we do dedicated bench infra.
Suzanne: Infra needs the VPC CIDR and KMS requirements from the customer. Also GPU quota request — provisioning queue is ~3 weeks.
Devin: Security needs the dataflow diagram + design doc to start threat model and KMS attestation. SOC2 docs are already requested.
Anya: Platform needs canary rollout config + tracing hooks. We also need token-level cost metrics in prod to validate economics during pilot.
Maya: Here's a simple gating matrix to agree on (high-level):
```
Gates:
1) Security review signed -> non-prod pilot
2) Infra provisioned -> private env + KMS
3) Runtime perf -> p99 <= 220ms on pilot config
4) Platform hooks -> canary + observability + alerts
5) Customer validation -> 2-week pilot -> sign-off
```
Ricardo: Can we parallelize 2 & 3? I can run perf on hosted infra with the same quant settings to get early p99 numbers while infra is queued. That buys ~2 weeks.
Suzanne: Parallel ok, but we still need final VPC CIDR + KMS type (HSM vs KMS) before we create the private env. Please send those by Mon. I'll open infra ticket.
Devin: I'll start the threat model as soon as you drop the design doc in the shared drive. Note: HSM attestation path adds extra steps — flagging now.
Anya: I'll prepare the canary config and observability checklist. Need to bump tracing SDK to v2.4 to capture per-request tokens; can do by EOD today.
Maya: Action items (quick):
- @Ricardo: prototype quant + perf baseline by next Tue
- @Anya: canary + tracing checklist by EOD
- @Suzanne: open infra ticket with GPU quota + VPC request (please include estimated lead time)
- @Devin: start threat model once design doc posted
- @Maya: I'll collect customer KMS/CIDR details and push them today
Ricardo: I'll also prepare a lightweight fallback plan: serve smaller model variant with `canary-2` flag if p99 > 220ms during pilot.
Suzanne: Ticket opened: infra#4321 — GPU quota request + VPC provisioning. ETA: initial approval in 5 business days.
deploy-bot: Ticket infra#4321 created by Suzanne (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/infra-4321)
Devin: Added a template checklist to the security drive for what I need in the design doc (data retention, network flow, KMS usage).
Maya: Great — reconvene Thu 10:00am to lock sequencing. I'll send invite. :thumbsup:
Ricardo: Thanks — will post perf notes to the thread as soon as I have the baseline.
Anya: I'll link the canary PR once ready.
Suzanne: Following up on approvals in #infra, will ping if quota increases required earlier.
Maya: Done — invite sent. If anyone needs to move it, reply here.
